name: Ashtanga Hridaya
author: Vagbhata
description: Ashtanga Hridaya is one of the three major classical texts of Ayurveda (Brihat Trayi), along with Charaka Samhita and Sushruta Samhita. Written by Vagbhata, it is a comprehensive compilation and systematization of Ayurvedic knowledge. The name means "Heart of the Eight Branches" referring to the eight limbs of Ayurveda (Ashtanga Ayurveda).
keyContributions: Systematic compilation of earlier Ayurvedic knowledge
Integration of Charaka and Sushruta traditions
Practical clinical protocols for daily practice
Madhura, Amla, Lavana, Katu, Tikta, Kashaya - six taste classifications with clinical applications
Detailed Nidana (etiology) and Chikitsa (treatment) for each disease
Sharirasthana chapters on conception, fetal development, and postnatal care
keyConcepts: Ashtanga Ayurveda - Eight branches of Ayurveda
Basti (enema) therapy as best Vata treatment
Graha Chikitsa - Treatment of psychological disorders
